name: Broadway Youth Center (drop-in, health and housing connections)
what_you_do: A drop-in center for young people. It offers medical care, social help and mental health care. It also links you to housing and other help.
who_can_apply: Anyone ages 12 to 24 can come to the center. Online appointment booking is only for ages 18 to 24, and patients under 18 cannot book online.
pay_detail: The page says services are available regardless of ability to pay.
deadline_text: No deadline. Drop-in hours are Mon 9 to 3, Tue 10 to 3, Wed 1 to 5, Thu 9 to 3, Fri 9 to 3.
how_to_apply: Walk in at 1023 W. Irving Park Road, Chicago, during drop-in hours, or call 773-388-1600.
notes: Support center, not a job. The page does not mention job or school programs, so ask staff. If you are in danger right now, call 911.
